data.title: New Account Sending Multiple Instant Payments
data.description: Detects accounts less than 30 days old that initiate multiple instant payments within a short time window. Newly opened accounts used for rapid instant-payment disbursement are a strong indicator of synthetic identity fraud or mule accounts created specifically for the monetization phase of a fraud scheme.

enrichment_required.source: Account analytics enrichment (account opening date lookup)

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for New Account Sending Multiple Instant Payments")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection and filter_new_account | count() by account_id > 5")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:instant_payments
event_type="instant_payment_initiated"
(payment_rail="ZELLE" OR payment_rail="FEDNOW" OR payment_rail="RTP" OR payment_rail="ACH_SAMEDAY")
account_age_days<30
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count > 5

falsepositives: Newly opened business account setting up recurring vendor payments
College student opening account and paying multiple roommates for shared expenses
